business_objective: Replace a volunteer shift assignment after both volunteers are confirmed eligible and the proposed substitute accepts the assignment.

stakeholder_statements.text: An original volunteer submits a shift-substitution request and identifies the assigned shift and proposed substitute.
The volunteer coordinator records whether the original volunteer and proposed substitute are eligible for the shift.
The original volunteer records a handover note for the shift duties.
The substitute volunteer records acceptance of the proposed shift assignment.

The shift records clerk replaces the original assignment with the substitute only after both volunteers are eligible and substitute acceptance is recorded. Recording attendance and reimbursing volunteer expenses are outside this project.

business_objective: Add an available compatible accessory to a rental reservation after the addition is accepted and acknowledged by the renter.

stakeholder_statements.text: A renter submits an accessory-addition request and identifies the reservation, rental item, and requested accessory.
The availability clerk records whether the requested accessory is available for the reserved period.
The compatibility checker records whether the requested accessory is compatible with the rental item.
The rental agreement clerk records the accessory addition as accepted or declined and adds a reason when it is declined.

The handover clerk adds the accepted accessory to the handover list only after availability, compatibility, and acceptance are recorded. The renter acknowledges the updated handover list. Pricing the accessory and delivering the rental item are outside this project.

business_objective: Review corrections to lienholder notice recipients and update accepted policy records when the proposed recipient has a documented interest in the insured asset.

stakeholder_statements.text: A policyholder submits a lienholder-notice correction and identifies the policy, insured asset, current notice recipient, and proposed recipient.
The policy records clerk records supporting evidence and the correction reason. The accepted evidence types have not been agreed.
The asset coverage reviewer records whether the proposed recipient has a documented interest in the insured asset. The documented-interest criteria are undecided.
The compliance reviewer records the correction as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The acceptance criteria are undecided.

The notice records clerk replaces the current notice recipient only after documented interest and correction acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the policyholder. The delivery channel is undecided. Processing claim payments and calculating premiums are outside this project.

business_objective: Review specimen-disposal attestations and close custody records after assignment reconciliation, witnessed disposal, and compliance acceptance.

stakeholder_statements.text: A laboratory custodian submits a specimen-disposal attestation and identifies the study, specimen set, and disposal event.
The inventory reviewer records whether every listed specimen is assigned to the disposal event. The reconciliation rule has not been agreed.
The disposal witness records whether the disposal event was observed and records supporting witness evidence. The accepted witness-evidence types have not been agreed.
The research compliance reviewer records the attestation as accepted or returned and adds a reason when it is returned. The acceptance criteria are undecided.

The custody records clerk closes the specimen custody records only after full assignment, witnessed disposal, and attestation acceptance are recorded, then sends the outcome to the laboratory custodian. The delivery channel is undecided. Performing physical specimen disposal and collecting new specimens are outside this project.

business_objective: Review requests to transfer components between assets while preserving an unresolved rule about removing components from standby donor assets.

stakeholder_statements.text: A maintenance planner submits a component-transfer review and identifies the donor asset, recipient asset, and component.

The reliability engineer records whether the component is technically compatible and records the recipient failure as critical or non-critical. The criteria for compatibility and criticality are not finalized. The engineer says the component may be removed from a standby donor when the recipient failure is critical.
The asset control reviewer records the donor asset as active, standby, or retired. The reviewer says the component must not be removed until the donor asset is retired.
The component custodian records the component's current custody location.

The maintenance governance officer records the request as approved or declined after compatibility, recipient criticality, donor status, and component custody information are present, then sends the outcome to the maintenance planner. Nobody has decided which donor-status rule controls, who resolves the disagreement, which delivery channel to use, or the maximum decision time. Physical component removal and repair work are outside this project; the meeting also drifted into complaints about the workshop heater.
